current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first source worktree lookup ran from the Codex home directory, exceeded its bound, and then reported that the location was not a Git repository.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the exact literal D-drive source path from the activation packet.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Resolve the source root before invoking repository-scoped Git.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A multi-file read initially reported the current auth-state reference missing; a later exact read found and validated the current state.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Validate the current state directly and retain the transient absence at zero credit.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat mutable current-state references as drift-prone and verify them immediately before use.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: PowerShell rejected a direct foreach block piped into JSON serialization.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize foreach results into a scalar array before piping.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement in this host.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined line and word count across seventeen required skill files exceeded its bounded window.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Read required skill files completely in small exact batches.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate many large skill reads into one cold command.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A sixty-line activation-packet display exceeded its bounded output window.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use System.IO.File.ReadAllLines with smaller scalar slices while preserving complete EOF coverage.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep large packet display chunks small even when the underlying read is local.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: PowerShell rejected an attempted parenthesized native Git command and exit-code projection.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Run the native command first, then capture LASTEXITCODE in a separate statement.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not group native commands and shell statements inside an expression.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The worktree-add wrapper timed out while checkout continued and ultimately completed successfully.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Inspect the exact process, lock, path marker, head, branch, and clean state before any retry.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: A wrapper timeout never proves a Git mutation failed or stopped.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first identity collision search used ambiguous quoting and split Windows paths into invalid arguments.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use separate literal patterns and an explicit repository root.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows searches to simple separately quoted patterns.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined status, branch, head, and catalogue-symbol inventory exceeded its bounded window without a trustworthy aggregate result.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Split cleanliness, revision, and exact-file searches into separate bounded probes.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine large-worktree status enumeration with unrelated source inspection.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first x1 build hashed CRLF-normalized working-tree baton bytes against a SHA-256 value that binds the LF committed Git blob and stopped before artifact generation.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Read the baton blob at the exact Eiren final commit and hash those immutable bytes.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Match every declared digest to its representation domain before comparison.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The second x1 preflight used stale or mistyped full names for Eiren's x1 and evidence anchors and Git rejected the nonexistent x1 object before artifact generation.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Derive the exact anchors from the verified final's actual single-parent log and committed receipts.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Copy immutable object names from live Git output rather than expanding abbreviated startup notes.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The third x1 preflight found 2,320 inherited rows but rejected twenty repeated historical identifier groups even though all 2,320 titles were unique.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Preserve every inherited row, report identifier collisions, and bind novelty to row content and title rather than assuming globally unique historical identifiers.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect frozen-index identifier and title cardinalities separately before choosing a uniqueness invariant.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first complete novelty screen found the original proposal 29 title too similar to Eiren's coffee public-data adapter template at 0.6129 and stopped before artifact generation.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Redesign the surface around a no-network occurrence-query tribunal with geometry and taxon filters, page-stop invariants, sensitive-coordinate suppression, publisher citation capture, and an empty-result witness.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Domain substitution alone is not a novel reusable-framework proposal.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first artifact privacy scan found one private absolute D-drive receipt path embedded in the x1 builder and blocked the packet.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Remove the local bank path from repository source and record only the sanitized receipt digest and completed pre-mutation verification.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Durable tools may bind receipt digests but must not publish private local bank paths.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A post-build runner discovery attempted a nonexistent repository script named ghc_family_auth_permission_state.py after the x1 tests had passed.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the validator path declared by the installed auth-permission-state skill.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Inspect a selected skill's declared script names instead of deriving a repository filename.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A follow-up discovery attempted a nonexistent skill-local validate_roster.py path even though the repository roster runner already existed.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the verified repository ghc_family_roster_check.py runner and the already successful startup validation.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not force symmetry between independently packaged skill and repository runner layouts.
